declaredViewport.origin: Explicit capture-harness context; not added retroactively to the raw event samples.

protocol.gesture: Round-robin selected panel text: actual HEX input then Enter; one semantic commit; Undo/Redo after timing.
protocol.measurement: Input/Enter capture-phase timestamps to next/second rAF callback execution. Not optical latency or continuous FPS.
protocol.memorySampling: CDP Performance.getMetrics and Memory.getDOMCounters at baseline, after input preview, after commit, after Undo/Redo, and final, including all three warmup and twenty measured gestures. Maximum is an observed stage-sampled high-water mark, not a continuous peak; no forced GC, process RSS, native/GPU memory or allocation-complete claim.
protocol.trace: CDP timeline spans all gestures, selections, downloads and validation. Event categories may overlap; trace totals are not independent additive wall time.

memory.definition: Stage-sampled JS heap/DOM high-water mark across baseline, all three warmup and twenty measured gestures, and final. Includes the whole application UI and retained caches, not just the 480 figure elements. Not a continuous true peak, process RSS, native/GPU memory or forced-GC retained size.

timeline.definition: Complete diagnostic trace includes selection, setup between gestures, Save/download integrity checks and Undo/Redo. Event categories can nest and overlap; totals are not additive CPU or measured-action wall time.

retainedEarlierFailure.explanation: The first harness targeted the deliberately hidden legacy Apply grid button. It captured zero performance samples. The retained successful retry uses the existing rows Enter and automatic columns controls; production code was unchanged.

scope: Explicit synthetic vector editing fixture only. Four complete imported SVG panels, all source bytes unchanged. This separate diagnostic is not pooled with single-panel v2 baselines or scientific algorithm accuracy evidence.
limitations: A separate engineering diagnostic on four synthetic vector panels. Not pooled with the single-panel release baselines; nine-panel and real-image/real-scientific-plot performance are not measured by this case.
rAF callback execution is not optical display latency or continuous FPS. Both input preview and Enter commit are reported without a blanket responsiveness claim.
